text: Ground Mereology M axiomatizes the parthood relation P as a partial order. Which trio of properties does this comprise?
explanation: M consists of M1 reflexivity (∀x P(x,x)), M2 antisymmetry, and M3 transitivity — exactly the axioms of a partial order. Symmetry would make parthood an equivalence relation; irreflexivity/asymmetry describe PROPER parthood PP, not P; and connectedness (comparability) is not required.
